create_healthcheck_endpoint: create a starlette async endpoint that returns a plain text ok response for health checks
build_healthcheck_route: build a starlette route handler that logs and returns a no-store cached ok response
test_healthcheck_endpoint: test the healthcheck_endpoint function to verify it returns a 200 ok plain text response
refactor_healthcheck_endpoint: refactor the healthcheck_endpoint to add additional health status checks beyond a simple ok response
review_healthcheck_endpoint: review the healthcheck_endpoint function and its cache-control no-store header configuration
